info.title: Ruby Developer API
info.description: Official public REST API for the Ruby Enterprise URL Shortener platform. Create, manage, and analyze branded short links and bulk campaigns programmatically.

post.description: Creates a new short link for the authenticated organization.

get.description:
Lists short links for the authenticated organization with cursor pagination.
Supports filtering by domain, is_active, group_public_id, and keyword search.
Reverse lookup for a short link by domain and short code.
Retrieves short link details by its public ID.

put.description: Updates short link destination, metadata, or status.

delete.description: Deactivates (soft delete) or purges (hard delete) a short link.

parameters.name: hard

schema.description: If true, permanently purges entity from Datastore. Default is soft deactivation.
schema.title: Hard

parameters.description: If true, permanently purges entity from Datastore. Default is soft deactivation.

get.description: Retrieves analytics metrics and breakdowns for a short link.

post.description: Creates a new link group / campaign for the authenticated organization.

get.description: Lists link groups for the active organization with cursor pagination.
Retrieves link group details by public_id.

delete.description:
Deactivates (soft delete) or purges (hard delete) a link group and all associated links.
- Soft delete (hard=False): Sets group.status = 'inactive' and invalidates Redis cache.
- Hard delete (hard=True): Sets group.status = 'deleting', invalidates Redis cache,
  and starts HardDeleteGroupWorkflow.

parameters.name: hard

schema.description: If true, permanently purges group and all links. Default is soft-delete.
schema.title: Hard

parameters.description: If true, permanently purges group and all links. Default is soft-delete.

get.description: Lists short links belonging to the specified group with cursor pagination.
Retrieves aggregated click analytics and breakdowns for all links in a group.

post.description:
High-throughput batch link creation inside a group (up to 500 links).
Enforces All-or-Nothing transactional consistency and plan link quotas.

get.description:
Exports all links in the specified group.
- If group is dynamic and has 0 links: generates a header-only CSV immediately and returns download URL.
- If group is dynamic and <= 2000 links: generates CSV immediately and returns download URL.
- If group is dynamic and > 2000 links:
    - If export is already ready (and refresh=False), returns download URL.
    - If export is not ready, triggers ExportGroupWorkflow and returns status='processing' (202).

parameters.name: refresh

schema.description: Force re-generation of export for dynamic groups
schema.title: Refresh

parameters.description: Force re-generation of export for dynamic groups

get.description:
Returns the list of domains available for creating short links:
1. Platform default domains (is_default=True).
2. Active verified custom branded domains belonging to the authenticated tenant (is_default=False).

interval.title: Interval

start_date.title: Start Date

is_default.title: Is Default

title.title: Title
title.description: Name of the link group or campaign

destination_url.title: Destination Url

HTTPBearer.description: Authentication with Bearer token formatted as `<key_id>:<key_secret>`. For enterprise authentication, provide HMAC signature headers (`X-Rby-Key-Id`, `X-Rby-Timestamp`, `X-Rby-Signature`).
